scope.experience: Agent completing a bounded coding task with reviewable edits and tool use
scope.task: Request a small repository change and relevant test run, inspect the tool activity and diff, and accept or revert the changes.
scope.configuration: Local coding Agent with repository access and terminal tools; human review before committing, merging or deployment. No particular model or run-mode configuration was tested.
scope.audience_perspective: A developer supervising an agent in a code repository

conversational.rationale: High-level natural-language requests, clarification and follow-up steering coexist with code review and editor controls.
conversational.uncertainty: Some tasks are executed with little further conversation; the product is focused on task completion.

specialization.rationale: Repository search, code editing, terminal tools and checkpoints are tailored to software development.
specialization.uncertainty: Web and image tools broaden capability, but the assessed workflow remains coding-specific.

autonomy.rationale: The agent can choose tools and perform multiple reads, edits and command runs from one goal without step-by-step user direction.
autonomy.uncertainty: Permissions and run modes determine what runs automatically. Human review and a bounded repository task keep this well below theoretical full agency.

accessibility.rationale: The editor lowers effort for developers, but effective oversight requires programming, repository and command-line understanding.
accessibility.uncertainty: Subscription access, project setup and platform support add barriers; no usability/accessibility study was conducted.

explainability.rationale: Tool activity, resulting code and restore checkpoints allow inspection of actions and consequences beyond a narrative answer.
explainability.uncertainty: Action traces and tests do not prove the rationale for every decision or correctness of every change.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: bounded Cursor coding Agent with edits and terminal tools, human review before release. Actual autonomy depends on permissions/run mode. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://cursor.com/docs/agent/overview and https://cursor.com/docs/agent/tools/terminal .
